Germán Barrionuevo is currently a PhD candidate in mechanical engineering under the supervision of Dr. Jorge Ramos at the Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile. He obtained his B.S. and M.S. degrees in Mechatronics and Computer-aided design and manufacturing at University of Armed Forces ESPE.
Prior to joining the CCWJ in January 2022, Germán was a research assistant at the materials science laboratory in Quito, Ecuador. His current research is focused on the development of novel additive manufacturing process to recover worn materials.

## Project

My research field is about the applicability of machine learning algorithms to predict the mechanical performance of samples fabricated by additive manufacturing and laser welding.
